title: Ha Tien Du Episode 2: The Waters That Remember
audience: Fans of Chinese fantasy, wuxia/xianxia drama viewers, 18-35 demographic who enjoy epic visual storytelling
tone: Heroic, melancholic, epic, cinematic, emotionally charged

concept.hook: The river remembered everything — every life it had touched, every secret whispered to its surface, every soul that had fallen within it.
concept.story_arc: River memory → Drowned palace → Her mother's ghost → The water speaks → Warning accepted
concept.emotion: Mystery → Wonder → Grief → Supernatural revelation → Grim resolve

shots.prompt: Extreme wide aerial — the celestial waterfall at night. The UPWARD cascading water glows with bioluminescent blue-green light. Camera slow push in through the cascading water — we see THROUGH the water to what lies beneath: an ancient drowned palace of white marble columns and golden domes, perfectly preserved under the surface. Camera: extreme wide push in through water to the palace. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Push in — extreme wide through glowing cascade to drowned palace, 6s
shots.narration: The river remembered everything. Every life it had touched. Every secret whispered to its surface. Every soul that had fallen within it.
shots.sfx: Deep water ambience, ethereal echo, bioluminescent shimmer

shots.prompt: Medium underwater shot — she swims gracefully through the submerged palace, her ice-blue Hanfu flowing around her like a jellyfish. Fish of pure light swim alongside her. Ancient golden writing glows on marble walls. She reaches a throne room where a woman in royal robes sits frozen at a golden desk, ink brush still in hand. Her mother. Camera: medium underwater shot, slow pan across the throne room. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Pan right — underwater palace throne room, frozen queen at desk, 6s
shots.narration: Her mother had died reaching for the truth. And in the river's memory, she had found her. Preserved. Waiting.
shots.sfx: Underwater ambient, bubble sounds, distant golden bell

shots.prompt: Extreme close-up — her mother's ghostly translucent hand reaches toward her face. The ghost's expression: loving, sorrowful. In the ghost's eyes we see visions — flash: a great war, a betrayal, a sealed door. The ghost mouths words: 'Do not open the door.' Tears stream down the living daughter's face underwater. Camera: extreme close-up, ghost hand touching her cheek, slow fade through visions. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Close-up — ghost mother's touch and vision montage, 6s
shots.narration: Her mother's final message: a warning. A door that must remain sealed. And a truth so dangerous that the river itself had drowned to keep it hidden.
shots.sfx: Ghost whisper, vision whoosh, single tear underwater, mournful strings

shots.prompt: Wide shot — the entire palace shakes. Ancient cracks spread across the marble. The water above churns. She gasps — the palace is collapsing back into darkness. She grabs her mother's frozen hand. The ghost transforms into glowing water that flows into her palm. A surge of power — her entire body glows blue-white. Camera: wide shot of palace crumbling, her silhouette glowing at the center. 6 seconds.
shots.camera: Pull back — palace collapsing, her hand absorbing glowing water, 6s
shots.narration: Her mother had dissolved into the water rather than be forgotten. And in that water lived her final gift: power enough to seal the door — forever.
shots.sfx: Palace crumbling, water surging, spirit energy explosion, epic bass boom

shots.prompt: Close-up — she bursts through the surface of the waterfall, gasping. She is changed — her eyes glow faintly blue, her Hanfu glitters with water-light. She stands on the cliff, trembling but determined. Behind her the palace below has vanished into perfect darkness. She looks toward the mortal world below with new purpose. Camera: full-body shot, slow cinematic push in to glowing-eyed close-up. 6 seconds. End on her face.
shots.camera: Push in — full body emerging from waterfall to determined glowing-eyed face, 6s
shots.narration: She emerged from the depths carrying her mother's soul like a lantern in the dark. The door must never open. And she would make sure of it.
shots.sfx: Water splash, wind, heartbeat, epic xianxia soundtrack swell

audio.narration: The river remembered everything. Every life it had touched. Every secret whispered to its surface. Every soul that had fallen within it. Her mother had died reaching for the truth. And in the river's memory, she had found her. Preserved. Waiting. Her mother's final message: a warning. A door that must remain sealed. And a truth so dangerous that the river itself had drowned to keep it hidden. Her mother had dissolved into the water rather than be forgotten. And in that water lived her final gift: power enough to seal the door — forever. She emerged from the depths carrying her mother's soul like a lantern in the dark. The door must never open. And she would make sure of it.
audio.bg_music: Mystical Chinese orchestral, guzheng and dizi flute leading, mournful yet epic, ethereal 75 BPM

specific_details.subject: Beautiful young woman, 18-22 years old, oval face, fair porcelain skin, high cheekbones, graceful features with a mix of fragility and inner steel
specific_details.outfit_exact: Flowing Hanfu with gold embroidery patterns on hems and sleeves, wide sleeves, high waist sash, silk fabric. Ornate hairpiece crowning long black hair in an elaborate updo
specific_details.setting_details: Ancient Chinese fantasy setting, misty mountains, temple courtyards, dramatic lighting
specific_details.face_expression: Varied by shot — serene, determined, sorrowful, fierce as appropriate
specific_details.body_movement: Graceful martial arts movements, ceremonial gestures, emotional expressions
specific_details.camera: Cinematic camera movements per scene — push-ins, pans, dramatic close-ups
